leastWorthwhile.text: Making the membrane supply was a little less clear on its own: the picture mentioned membrane-making structures without explaining them, though it showed the sacs were not yet part of the boundary.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the new membrane first stayed in small sacs instead of immediately enlarging the cell boundary.
